issues.body: Section 5 now claims that W1-W6 are filed as tracking issues, but none of the entries cites an issue or bead ID, and the stated dependency edges are present only in this Markdown. The change therefore provides no verifiable durable identities or dependency graph for the executable plan. Section 5.2 also explicitly defers filing several executable work items until decisions are answered, leaving future work recorded only in Markdown. This is materially the same beads-only task-tracking violation reported in round 2.
issues.fix_hint: Create or deduplicate durable beads for each actionable work item, encode dependencies in the tracker, and cite the resulting IDs beside W1-W6 and any decision-gated work. Maintainer decisions may remain open questions, but their known conditional implementation work should still have durable tracking without preselecting an answer; describe alternative acceptance criteria or block the task on the decision.
issues.title: The phased plan still lacks verifiable durable task records

verdict.summary: Round 3 changes the plan from saying no task records exist to asserting that W1-W6 were filed as tracking issues, but it supplies no issue or bead identifiers, so the asserted durable tracking and dependency edges cannot be verified from the change. It also continues to leave executable future work in section 5.2 without task records until decisions are made. The prior major finding therefore remains materially unresolved; progress is stagnant.
